question: Which team lost the most regular-season games in 2022-23 after leading by 15 or more points at some point in the game, and how many?
answer:
In the 2022-23 NBA regular season, the **Washington Wizards** and the **Atlanta Hawks** tied for the most games lost after leading by 15 or more points, with **8** such blown-lead losses each. 

The table below lists the teams that blew the most 15+ point leads and lost in the 2022-23 regular season, based on the 1,106 games with play-by-play data:

| Team | Blown 15+ Pt Lead Losses | Total Losses (with Play-by-Play) | % of Losses That Were Blown Leads | Largest Blown Lead in This Group |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Washington Wizards (WAS)** | **8** | 41 | 19.5% | 20 points (vs. POR on Feb 3, 2023; lost 124-116) |
| **Atlanta Hawks (ATL)** | **8** | 36 | 22.2% | 24 points (at SAS on Mar 19, 2023; lost 126-118) |
| **Portland Trail Blazers (POR)** | **7** | 48 | 14.6% | 25 points (vs. LAL on Jan 22, 2023; lost 121-112) |
| **Boston Celtics (BOS)** | **6** | 23 | 26.1% | 28 points (vs. BKN on Mar 3, 2023; lost 115-105) |
| **Dallas Mavericks (DAL)** | **6** | 40 | 15.0% | 27 points (vs. LAL on Feb 26, 2023; lost 111-108) |
| **Chicago Bulls (CHI)** | **6** | 39 | 15.4% | 24 points (at IND on Feb 15, 2023; lost 117-113) |
| **New Orleans Pelicans (NOP)** | **6** | 33 | 18.2% | 24 points (at PHX on Dec 17, 2022; lost 118-114) |

### Key Insights & Context
* **Late-Game Execution**: Both top-ranked teams struggled during crunch time. In "clutch time"—defined as the **4th quarter or overtime, 5:00 or less left, with the score within 5 points going into the play**—Atlanta was outscored by **58 points** (in 39 clutch games) and Washington was outscored by **24 points** (in 38 clutch games).
* **The Irony of Head-to-Head**: One of Washington's 8 blown leads came directly at the hands of the other biggest lead-blower. On March 8, 2023, the Wizards built a 15-point lead against the Atlanta Hawks, only to blow it and lose 122-120.

### Caveats & What We Could Not Establish
* **Missing Game Play-by-Play**: This dataset has play-by-play logs for 1,106 of the 1,230 scheduled regular-season games in 2022-23 (approximately 90% coverage). We **could not establish** if any team suffered additional 15-point blown-lead losses in the 124 games lacking play-by-play tracking, as maximum in-game margins cannot be verified without play-by-play logs.
* **Association vs. Causation**: While poor clutch shooting and high turnovers are closely associated with these blown leads, this observational data cannot establish a singular cause for why these leads were lost.

{"examples": [{"id": "blown_leads_by_team", "question": "Which teams have most often lost after leading by 15+ points (all seasons)?", "sql": "SELECT loser AS team, COUNT(*) AS losses, SUM(comeback_15::INT) AS losses_after_leading_15,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(comeback_15::INT) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_of_losses
FROM game_swings
GROUP BY loser
ORDER BY losses_after_leading_15 DESC
LIMIT 10"}, {"id": "q3_lead_hold_rate", "question": "How often does a team that leads by 10+ after three quarters hold on to win, by lead size?", "sql": "WITH q3 AS (SELECT game_id, home_margin AS m3 FROM plays WHERE event_type = 'PERIOD_END' AND period = 3),
lead AS (
  SELECT q.game_id, ABS(m3) AS lead_pts, (m3 > 0) = g.home_won AS held
  FROM q3 q JOIN games g USING (game_id) WHERE ABS(m3) >= 10)
SELECT CASE WHEN lead_pts >= 20 THEN '20+' WHEN lead_pts >= 15 THEN '15-19' ELSE '10-14' END AS lead_after_q3,
       COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(held::INT) AS held_on, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(held::INT), 1) AS hold_pct
FROM lead GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}, {"id": "team_clutch_net", "question": "Which teams outscore opponents the most in clutch time (2022-23 regular season)?", "sql": "SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS clutch_games, SUM(clutch_pts_for) AS pts_for, SUM(clutch_pts_against) AS pts_against,
       SUM(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against) AS net_pts,
       ROUND(AVG(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against), 2) AS net_per_game
FROM team_game_clutch
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season'

ORDER BY net_pts DESC
LIMIT 10"}]}

args.query:
SELECT 
    loser AS team, 
    COUNT(*) AS total_losses, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN comeback_15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blown_15_point_leads,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN comeback_15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_of_losses
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
GROUP BY loser
ORDER BY blown_15_point_leads DESC, total_losses DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    game_id, 
    game_date, 
    home_team, 
    away_team, 
    pts_home, 
    pts_away, 
    winner, 
    loser, 
    home_max_lead, 
    away_max_lead,
    winner_max_deficit
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 
  AND season_type = 'Regular Season' 
  AND comeback_15 = TRUE
  AND loser IN ('WAS', 'ATL')
ORDER BY loser, game_date;

SELECT 
    team,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN won THEN 1 END) AS wins,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT won THEN 1 END) AS losses,
    COUNT(*) AS total_games
FROM (
    SELECT home_team AS team, home_won AS won FROM games WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team AS team, NOT home_won AS won FROM games WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
)
WHERE team IN ('WAS', 'ATL', 'POR', 'DAL', 'CHI', 'NOP', 'BOS')
GROUP BY team;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM other_stats os
JOIN games g USING (game_id)
WHERE g.season_start_year = 2022 AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_swings WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season';

SELECT 
    game_date,
    CASE WHEN home_team = 'WAS' THEN 'vs ' || away_team ELSE 'at ' || home_team END AS opponent,
    CASE WHEN home_team = 'WAS' THEN home_max_lead ELSE away_max_lead END AS max_lead,
    winner AS opponent_winner,
    pts_home || '-' || pts_away AS final_score
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 
  AND season_type = 'Regular Season' 
  AND comeback_15 = TRUE
  AND loser = 'WAS'
ORDER BY game_date;

SELECT 
    game_date,
    CASE WHEN home_team = 'ATL' THEN 'vs ' || away_team ELSE 'at ' || home_team END AS opponent,
    CASE WHEN home_team = 'ATL' THEN home_max_lead ELSE away_max_lead END AS max_lead,
    winner AS opponent_winner,
    pts_home || '-' || pts_away AS final_score
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 
  AND season_type = 'Regular Season' 
  AND comeback_15 = TRUE
  AND loser = 'ATL'
ORDER BY game_date;

SELECT 
    team, 
    COUNT(*) AS clutch_games, 
    SUM(clutch_pts_for) AS pts_for, 
    SUM(clutch_pts_against) AS pts_against,
    SUM(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against) AS net_pts,
    ROUND(AVG(clutch_pts_for - clutch_pts_against), 2) AS net_per_game
FROM team_game_clutch
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 AND season_type = 'Regular Season' AND team IN ('WAS', 'ATL')
GROUP BY team;

SELECT 
    loser,
    MAX(winner_max_deficit) AS max_blown_lead
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 
  AND season_type = 'Regular Season' 
  AND comeback_15 = TRUE
  AND loser IN ('POR', 'BOS', 'CHI', 'DAL', 'NOP')
GROUP BY loser;

SELECT 
    game_date, 
    loser, 
    winner, 
    winner_max_deficit, 
    pts_home, 
    pts_away
FROM game_swings
WHERE season_start_year = 2022 
  AND season_type = 'Regular Season' 
  AND loser IN ('BOS', 'DAL', 'POR', 'CHI', 'NOP') 
  AND winner_max_deficit >= 24;
